FisicaBitSerial.leerSensorInterno|block: Reads an internal micro:bit sensor and returns its value.
FisicaBitSerial.leerSensorAnalogico|bloc: Reads an analog sensor connected to a pin (0-1023).
FisicaBitSerial.medirDistanciaUltrasonid: Measures distance with an HC-SR04 ultrasonic sensor.
FisicaBitSerial.enviar1|block: Sends the micro:bit time (ms) and one measured value to fisicabit.com via Bluetooth, then waits until the next sample. Only transmits while the page is connected. Line: time,value. Recommended 50 ms or more.
FisicaBitSerial.enviar1|param|valor: Value to send (sensor, variable or calculation)
FisicaBitSerial.enviar2|block: Sends the micro:bit time and two measured values to fisicabit.com via Bluetooth, then waits until the next sample.
FisicaBitSerial.enviar3|block: Sends the micro:bit time and three measured values to fisicabit.com via Bluetooth, then waits until the next sample.
FisicaBitSerial.enviar4|block: Sends the micro:bit time and four measured values to fisicabit.com via Bluetooth, then waits until the next sample.
FisicaBitSerial.bucleMuestreo|block: Fast loop for fisicabit.com via Bluetooth: runs the inner code every X ms with precise timing. Put the send block inside; its "every ... ms" is ignored inside the loop. 50 ms or more recommended over Bluetooth.
FisicaBitSerial.bucleMuestreo|param|cuer: Code to run on each sample
FisicaBitSerial.tiempoSerial|block: Time in milliseconds since USB streaming started (starts at 0).
FisicaBitSerial.enviarTimestamp|block: Enables or disables sending the micro:bit time as the first column. Must match the "Micro:bit sends timestamp" option on fisicabit.com.
FisicaBitSerial.enviarTimestamp|param|ac: true = send time (default), false = values only
FisicaBitSerial.fijarDecimales|block: Number of decimals used for non-integer values. Fewer decimals = smoother Bluetooth.
FisicaBitSerial.enviarLinea|block: Sends a free text line over USB.
FisicaBitSerial.enviar1|param|ms: Time between samples in ms (100 = 10 per second), eg: 100
FisicaBitSerial.enviar2|param|ms: Time between samples in ms, eg: 100
FisicaBitSerial.enviar3|param|ms: Time between samples in ms, eg: 100
FisicaBitSerial.enviar4|param|ms: Time between samples in ms, eg: 100
FisicaBitSerial.bucleMuestreo|param|ms: Time between samples in ms, eg: 50
FisicaBitSerial.enviarSinTiempo1|block: Sends only one measured value to fisicabit.com via Bluetooth, without the micro:bit time and without waiting: it is sent the moment the block runs. Use it on a button press or inside "forever" with your own pause. On fisicabit.com: "Micro:bit sends timestamp" disabled.
FisicaBitSerial.enviarSinTiempo2|block: Sends only two measured values to fisicabit.com via Bluetooth, without the micro:bit time and without waiting: it is sent the moment the block runs. Use it on a button press or inside "forever" with your own pause. On fisicabit.com: "Micro:bit sends timestamp" disabled.
FisicaBitSerial.enviarSinTiempo3|block: Sends only three measured values to fisicabit.com via Bluetooth, without the micro:bit time and without waiting: it is sent the moment the block runs. Use it on a button press or inside "forever" with your own pause. On fisicabit.com: "Micro:bit sends timestamp" disabled.
FisicaBitSerial.enviarSinTiempo4|block: Sends only four measured values to fisicabit.com via Bluetooth, without the micro:bit time and without waiting: it is sent the moment the block runs. Use it on a button press or inside "forever" with your own pause. On fisicabit.com: "Micro:bit sends timestamp" disabled.
